findings.text: the straddle assertion rests on the two offsets pinned at :61, which the source node's own brief measured booking cell 266 ordinary in both readings on the Broadwell node class this dispatch runs on (98dci4-clu-2068), and the guard has never been observed green at a7ea79849: job 1295254 failed both tests in this file by 300 s timeout and the paired gate's tip arm exited 124 with an empty log. The round ships an assertion expected to redden on a host class the gate runs on instead of the run-time bisection to the switch the brief asked for.

baseline_suite and after_suite record three of the seven rows each gate arm produced and omit both tests/equilibrium/test_read_correction_path.py rows (base exit 0 with 2 passed in 292.75s, tip exit 124 with an empty log), so a reader of the recorded fields cannot see that the file this round changed has no readable head arm; the tests line at manifest.md:121 carries <arm-root> and <scratch> placeholders and is not a re-runnable command.

the sliver control branches on _disk_weight_fraction (:100), which books SQUARE while the asserted cell is the triangle CELL (:119), so at radius 0.2 -- where the nearest cell edge lies 0.4025 from the disk centre and the disk is wholly inside the cell -- it takes the crossing branch and reddens only because shrinking the disk moves about 5.3e-4 of current against a 2e-4 tolerance, not because a sliver at a crossing was dropped.

the declared literal negative control --force-conic-right is exercised only through _moments at :68, while the continuity assertion this round rewrote at :299 asserts _inside (:133), which never passes force_whole, so the mutation the done_when names cannot reach the assertion it was declared to falsify.

_polar_reference re-derives the ring-against-inscribed-polygon area and first moments that _reference_moments at :397 already owns through shapely, duplicating the unit-density oracle instead of extending it; only the density-weighted form has no existing owner.
